title: Satchakranirupanacitram (Illustrated Six Chakras)
shelf_note: An illustrated Indian chakra chart-book. The plate fits a tantric/yoga subject, but the record has no tradition and no collections to check it against.
rights_flag: Undated, but the leaf is a modern colour-printed plate with an English anatomical caption faintly visible ("EPIGASTRIC PLEXUS") beside Devanagari. It looks like a 20th-century publication. Check the author's dates and the imprint before treating it as public domain.
structure_note: structure.pages_translated is 0 while the book field and this page show a translation, so the counter disagrees with the record (E2). Of the 32 printed numbers, 6 step backwards and 4 repeat. On a book of plates I read that as plate leaves and misread or absent numerals, not a splice. From one page I cannot confirm it.

pages.layout: full-page colour chakra plate: a lotus of about ten pale blue-grey petals around a circle, with a large seed syllable carrying a crescent-and-dot and two seated figures inside its bowl. Underneath sits a faint, almost washed-out text layout with a heading block at top right (Devanagari plus English "EPIGASTRIC PLEXUS"), a small anatomical drawing at top left, labels around the lotus and ruled tables at the foot. There are red ink specks.

ocr_errors.image: The large letter is a single stem from the headline, a bowl to the right and a tail sweeping down-left, under a crescent and dot. That is र with candrabindu (raṃ). It is not ह, which has the extra left-hand hook.
ocr_errors.problem: The seed syllable is misread. Raṃ is the bīja of Maṇipūra, Haṃ that of Viśuddha. The misread turns the whole page into the wrong chakra.

ocr_errors.image: The faint heading block at top right carries the English "EPIGASTRIC PLEXUS" (the solar plexus, i.e. Maṇipūra). The lotus has about ten petals, not sixteen.
ocr_errors.problem: The chakra is named as Viśuddha (throat) where the plate shows Maṇipūra (navel/epigastric). No printed "विशुद्ध" is visible.

book_verdict: The plate shows Maṇipūra: the bīja is raṃ, the lotus has about ten petals, and the faint caption reads "EPIGASTRIC PLEXUS". The OCR and English label it Viśuddha/Haṃ, fill a table the image does not let me read with Viśuddha attributes, and back the error with notes and a summary. The faint text layer is not transcribed.
